name: Metta Offline
detailed_description:
Metta Offline is a 2.5D single player indie RPG set in a fantasy interpretation of ancient India. The gameplay is reminiscent of popular 2000s era RPGS, namely Ragnarök Online, Diablo 2, and RuneScape. Rich and thought provoking quests inspired by Buddhist themes and stories await you.

Level your character

Level up and gain access to skill and stat points. Build your character however you want. 

Choose from unique jobs

Choose from a variety of job classes according to your playstyle. Do you want to play carefully as a mage, or gung-ho as a fighter? Each job class will be able to specialize further with second and third jobs. 

Complete exciting and thought provoking quests

Our quests are designed similarly to RuneScape. Each quest line features a standalone story that occurs over multiple quests. There is no main quest and no requirement to engage with the story if you prefer to focus on other aspects of the game. However, players who complete quests will find unique, engaging stories and will be rewarded for their efforts.

Face great challenges

For players who want to push their skills and game knowledge to the limits, there will be challenging areas, dungeons, and boss fights. Face giant slimes, powerful demons, and vicious beasts. Victory will not be guaranteed!

Follow our progress on social media!

Please feel free to follow us on YouTube, Reddit, Discord, or our other social media platforms. We will be more than happy to engage with your feedback! Also, keep an eye out for open playtests in the future.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.4 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 950, Radeon R7 360, or Intel HD Graphics 630
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • VR Support: None

content_descriptors.notes: This game will contain stories that touches on sensitive topics such as loss of loved ones, war, etc.
